# SC2005: skip-self-dependency-violation

## Meaning

The compiler emitted this diagnostic for skip self dependency violation. The declaration or generated contract violates a statically checkable SupaCloud rule.

## Fix

Correct the provider or token declaration associated with `skip-self-dependency-violation`. Prefer a named provider, an explicit module export, and a boundary owned by the consuming layer.

## Reproduction

Place the example below in a focused compiler fixture and assert that `SC2005` is reported with a file location. The fixture must fail before the fix and pass after it.

## Failing Example

```ts
// Expected diagnostic: SC2005
@Module({ name: "child", providers: [TOKEN] })
class ChildModule {}
// @SkipSelf() cannot resolve a token from the current module.
class Consumer { constructor(@SkipSelf() value: typeof TOKEN) {} }
```
